items.title: Robert Glasper interviewed by Greg Thomas, Clinton, New York, February 20, 2016
items.q: I have a 7-year-old son myself. So when I’m not crazy he gets all my — he’s here. You know. Yeah, Robbie’s here.

ctx.x: Yes, and I love it. I really do, I love it. My question is do you, or do you have a staff, are you mentoring any other people who would like to be in the industry or in the music?

I don’t have time at the moment. I do have like, you know, if cats come to New York and I’m in New York and I’m doing something I have a few younger cats that they want to come through and hang out and check it out, they can do that periodically here and there. But I haven’t done an actual like mentor thing yet, like hard core. Because I’m just all over the place. And I even tried to give lessons for a year and that didn’t work out. Because just my schedule was too crazy and I have a 7-year-old son myself. So…
Well it used to be where cats would play a jazz gig or a blues gig or R&B, a bar mitzvah.
